sceneTitle.description: Title shown in the browser tab and page header

defaultSplatPath.description: Relative path under public/ to a .ply splat loaded on startup (e.g. splats/scene.ply)

defaultModelPath.description: Relative path under public/ to a .glb model loaded on startup

backgroundColor.description: Three.js hex colour for the scene background (e.g. #1a1a24)

enableWalkMode.description: Whether first-person walk mode is enabled by default (true) or orbit-only (false)
